graph_source.note: Layer-1 code-graph substrate. 'cbm' = codebase-memory-mcp (MCP-native, queried live by the agent; OPTIONAL — only where that MCP exists). 'graphify' = local tree-sitter graph whose Obsidian notes are folded into the vault (portable baseline). See Decisions/0001.

graphify.note: mode 'code-only' = pure local AST, zero egress. Set backend to 'ollama' (local) to also extract docs/PDFs + name communities. Refresh with graphify_refresh.sh.

route_scan.note: Set enabled=false for non-web repos. Override 'patterns' (list of regexes, 1-2 capture groups) for non-Python stacks; examples are in build_brain.py.
